_readme: Luke edits this file, nobody else. The bot re-reads it before every order and stops (places nothing) if anything here is missing or invalid. Numbers marked PLACEHOLDER are paper-only starting values, not Luke's limits.
_filters: Filter ids from filters.js, in priority order. When several fire on the same pick, the order is credited to the first one listed here. Starting set: every filter currently marked 'Likely real edge' (z >= 2.5), strongest first.
_watchFilters: Logged as 'would have fired' only. Never orders, never count toward limits.
_unitUsd: Dollars per unit. Not needed for paper (everything is in units). Live mode refuses to start while this is null.

limits._placeholders: maxUnitsPerDay, maxOpenUnits and lossStopUnits are PLACEHOLDERS for paper. Day = Central time. Loss stop = drawdown from the high point of settled results since lossStopResetAt.

checks._note: Suggestions to test on paper, not findings. Rise: the limit price is the whale's price + this; above it the order rests until it fills or the cutoff. Drop: if the price fell this far below the whale's, the market moved against the whale, so skip.
